
# Filling in the Details {#sec-details}

## Gradual and Immediate Templates

### Translating Templates {.unnumbered}

So far, we've just been talking about Gradual and Immediate templates, but these are not the terms used by Actual Budget. We need a system to translate the Actual Budget-native template types to either Gradual or Immediate for use in this algorithm

::::: {.columns}
::: {.column}
**Immediate**

* Simple Type
* Periodic Type
* Percent Type
* Schedule Type (with `full` flag)
* Average Type
* Copy Type
:::

::: {.column}
**Gradual**

* By Type
* Schedule Type (without `full` flag)
:::
:::::

Remainder Type templates are considered separately, after all other templates have run, as they are now. Limits on categories (i.e. `up to`) function the same as they do now, also.
